# mtl5_bench capability card -- i7-12700k

<!-- Generated by benchmarks/publish_platform.cmake from benchmarks/data/i7-12700k/mtl5_bench/20261112T004852Z/.
     Do not edit by hand: publish a new session instead (benchmarks/README.md). -->

The platform benchmark's capability cards for the `i7-12700k` machine described on the
[benchmark systems](systems.md) page: every operation family, measured against this
machine's FMA peak and memory bandwidth (#721). This page shows the latest published
session; every session's raw results stay in the data directory.

Repeatability: 608 of 666 entries within +-5% of the previous session, measured after a cold boot on the same commit (median ratio 0.996 to 1.002 per run; benchmarks/compare_sessions.py). The largest outliers are single-thread dense eigensolvers (schur, eigen_symmetric, eigenvalue, sylvester: 1.5-1.8x slower in this session). A crash-looping microk8s pod restarted a container about every 13 s during both sessions, so it adds background load to both rather than biasing one. Relates to #721 and #737.
